title: When people describe your life one day…
paragraphs:
When people describe your life one day…
what will they say you were known for?

Tabitha didn’t preach sermons.
She sewed clothes.
And the people she helped never forgot.
Sometimes the most powerful legacy is quiet goodness.

But when she died,
the whole community cried.
Not every life changes the world from a stage.

Some change it from a table
with a needle, thread, and a generous heart.
Tabitha was simply known for doing good.
And that was enough to make heaven notice.

“Small acts. Quiet faith. Lasting impact.
What’s one good thing you can do for someone this week?”
